Record Class MobileRecordingOptions

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.shaft.gui.driver.MobileRecordingOptions
Record Components:
timeLimit - provider recording limit from one second through 30 minutes
maxBytes - maximum decoded response size from one byte through 256 MiB
public record MobileRecordingOptions(Duration timeLimit, long maxBytes) extends Record
Bounded options for one Appium mobile screen-recording session.
